resources.string: ComfyFlux is a native Android front end for your own ComfyUI server. Pick a workflow, set the prompt, size and seed, queue the job and review the results, all from your phone on the local network. This is a maintained fork of the original ComfyFlux by Elton Kola.
Make sure your ComfyUI server is online and on the same network (start it with: python main.py --listen).\nComfyFlux is a minimal front end for simple flows.
